thread:
Priya Patel: Quick sync — we're proposing a phased deprecation for the legacy X-Partner-Token header. Targeting rollout in ~6 weeks. want to align marketplace vendors + SI partners.
Luis Gomez: timeline? any hard cutover date?
Priya Patel: tentative: announce Apr 8, beta opt-in Apr 15, canary rollout Apr 29, full enforcement Jun 3. enforcement only for non-opted-in partners after grace.
Tom Chen: plan for compatibility shims? Partners still on old header should be able to route via a shim for 6 months.
Ava Rivera: If we publish a shim as a marketplace package, we need security review + listing cert — that's ~2 week lead. MarketplaceBot: action required: please file marketplace security checklist for "auth-shim" asset.
Nina Kapoor: For SI integrations, request we provide: migration checklist, CI test harness, and a curl example they can run in staging. propose a 3-step partner checklist doc.
Luis Gomez: agree. Also need telemetry hooks to detect shim usage (so we know who's still on old header). can we add X-Compat-Used header for reporting?
Tom Chen: yes — shim will add X-Compat-Used: shim-v1 to proxied requests. We'll ship a small docker image + helm chart.
Priya Patel: sample migration snippet to include in guide:
```
# migrate: replace X-Partner-Token with Authorization
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     -d '{"input":"hello"}' \
     https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate
```
Luis Gomez: solid. For partners that can't change, offer an opt-in shim install via Marketplace or self-hosted helm. Need comms for both.
Ava Rivera: Joint announcement plan: partners who adopt during beta get a co-marketing badge. we need partner legal sign-off on badge usage.
Nina Kapoor: Testing matrix: SDKs (python/js), webhook re-sign, SI connector (MuleSoft/Boomi), on-prem gateway. We should create a CSV compatibility matrix and send to top 12 partners.
Priya Patel: decision points:
- Offer shim via Marketplace (yes) — Ava to start cert intake (due Apr 1)
- Provide self-host helm + docker (yes) — Tom to publish image + helm (due Apr 10)
- Beta opt-in list & co-marketing badge (Nina/Luis to own partner outreach; due Apr 12)
- Telemetry: add X-Compat-Used header + metric (Tom + Eng-telemetry; due Apr 5)
Luis Gomez: will notify partner success about targeted outreach and draft partner email.
Ava Rivera: I'll open the marketplace listing ticket and tag security.
MarketplaceBot: marketplace-listing-12345 created by Ava Rivera — security-review pending.
Tom Chen: quick note on SLA: shims will add ~25ms p95; need to mention in partner docs and FAQ.
Nina Kapoor: risk: SI connectors with strict schema validators may drop new Auth header. we'll include a validation snippet and a fallback mapping for common middleware.
Priya Patel: ok team — I'll draft the public partner comms and the migration guide. assigning: Ava (marketplace cert), Tom (shim + helm + telemetry), Luis/Nina (partner outreach + matrix). I'll share first draft by Mar 28.
Luis Gomez: thanks — tagging @here in partners channel once draft ready. :thumbsup:
Ava Rivera: noted.
Tom Chen: starting shim repo now.
MarketplaceBot: reminder set for Apr 1: marketplace security review deadline.
